purpose: One-read 20-asset evaluation of a causal expanding ExtraTrees plus WaveField veto selected on disjoint development assets.

source.integrity: Every available archive file must pass the provider CHECKSUM before it enters a gzip bundle. Canonical klines are mandatory; missing derivative files are explicitly recorded.

selection_evidence.negative_control: One of three deterministic asset hash folds reached only 0.63 accuracy. The final holdout therefore tests transfer rather than claiming universal development stability.

candidate_event.threshold_scope: per asset using only feature history before each period
candidate_event.overlap_control: At most one candidate per asset until the previous 24h target matures.

extra_trees_head.sample_weight: inverse number of training events sharing the same timestamp

joint_veto.decision: Emit an up forecast only when both the expanding ExtraTrees head and the expanding positive-vs-negative WaveField memory assign at least 0.55 up probability.

causality.model_updates: Before each holdout fold, both models are rebuilt from training-asset events whose 24h labels matured before that fold began.
causality.asset_isolation: No holdout-asset label is used for training, model updates, normalization, threshold selection, or calibration.
causality.time_isolation: Candidate thresholds use features before the evaluated period. Outcome labels are never used until their target timestamp has passed.
causality.dependence_control: Signals are reported as asset observations, UTC market blocks, and market episodes separated by more than 48 hours.
causality.holdout_policy: No asset, feature, parameter, threshold, fold, direction, gate, or final sample size may change after this file is committed. A failed gate remains reported.
